description: Finish signing in with the 6-digit code from the email (works without an API key). Creates a new API key for the account, saves it (~/.vivideo/config.json) and uses it for every Vivideo tool — the key is never shown. Returns the account plan and credits; if there is no plan yet, start_checkout buys one. If a key is already configured, the new key is NOT saved or used (status key_issued_not_saved): the user switches accounts with `vivideo login`.
name: verify_login_code
